# Nepathya Fashion Academy & Boutique, Belagavi

> Fashion designing academy and designer boutique in Sadashiv Nagar, Belagavi (Belgaum), Karnataka, India. Founded by award-winning fashion designer Ms. Pooja Dalal (15+ years of experience). Government of India MSME registered. One-to-one, 100% practical training with live boutique order exposure. 4.9-star Google rating.

## Courses
- 45 Days Fashion Designing Course (beginners): basic sewing, hand embroidery, textile designing, kids wear and kurtis, saree blouses and skirts.
- 3 Months Advanced Fashion Designing Course: advanced sewing techniques, designer kurtis and blouses, Aari work, western outfits, padded blouses.
- 6 Months Professional Fashion Designing Course: advanced pattern making, professional garment construction, bridal and designer wear, advanced Aari work, boutique business training.
- Online fashion designing classes: live interactive sessions with an industry professional, course completion certificate.

## Key facts
- Admissions open, limited seats per batch, flexible admissions.
- Free sewing kit worth ₹5,000 with every admission.
- Awards: Super Woman Award 2023 (Best Boutique and Academy in Belgaum), presented by actress Malaika Arora; Forever Star India Awards (FSIA) Best Boutique & Academy in Belagavi 2023.
- Boutique: custom bridal blouses, lehengas, gowns, kurtis and Indo-western wear.
- Fees: on request.
